'''Setenna Hase''' was a [[Senior Advisor/Legends|Senior Advisor]] who helped to found the [[Ardan resistance]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Hase was kidnapped by the traitorous [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Var Narek]].<ref name="OAA1" />
